rationale: No change: no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment are added. Every question of this run is recorded as explained with a retained receipt or an explicit source-only basis, no necessary gap is open, every execution carries an interpretation, and the remaining budget expires with this turn. A further sourced entry would restate mechanisms already recorded and an experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it a conclusion, so neither would be useful investigation; expiry preserves the existing work and needs no closing call.
